_notes: Site-wide settings read by build.py and exposed to the templates as `site`.
analytics.provider: one of "" (off), "ga4", "cloudflare", "plausible". The snippet is in templates/includes/analytics.html and goes on every page.
ga4: set ga4_measurement_id (G-XXXXXXXXXX). The snippet runs Google Consent Mode with analytics denied until the visitor accepts the cookie banner (needed for EU visitors).
cloudflare: set cloudflare_token (the token from the Web Analytics site; no cookies, no banner; the domain's DNS must be on Cloudflare or the beacon is added as JS).
plausible: set plausible_domain (pauldejong.com); no cookies, no banner; paid.
